title: OpenSearch Dashboards console is reachable without authentication
description: The OpenSearch Dashboards application is served without authentication. Dashboards ships with a dev-tools console that sends arbitrary requests to the search cluster from the browser.
remediation: Enable the security plugin on both the cluster and Dashboards, and keep Dashboards on the internal network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the OpenSearch Dashboards console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · OpenSearch Dashboards</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
